title: Journeys, cities and places
summary: Use the lemma and context to select the form.

now.sentenceGloss: I am travelling to the theatre now.
now.note: Present tense: я їду, the first person singular of їхати.

often.sentenceGloss: Every Monday I travel to the office.
often.note: Present tense: їздити is a second conjugation verb, so я їжджу.

we.sentenceGloss: At this moment we are travelling across the bridge.
we.note: Present tense: first person plural of їхати.

they.sentenceGloss: Our neighbours travel to the lake every summer.
they.note: Present tense: third person plural of їздити.

town.note: Locative singular: місто in the second case singular.

place.sentenceGloss: There will be a stop at this place.
place.note: Locative singular: місце in the second case singular.

towns.note: Locative plural: в трьох містах, the second case plural.

places.sentenceGloss: Parking is prohibited in these places.
places.note: Locative plural: у цих місцях, the second case plural.

plane.sentenceGloss: They are travelling abroad by plane.
plane.note: Instrumental: the means of travel takes the instrumental.

train.sentenceGloss: This time we are travelling by train.
train.note: Instrumental: the means of travel takes the instrumental.
